advice.headline: Stay the course

moves.text: Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.4 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 30%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 39% of the time with the first-round bye and 23% without it. You get the bye in 44% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (180.6 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 30%, 26%, 32%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (3 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
